name: Connection Declaration
definition: Holds each declared connection to an external service, with the service, the account, the scopes of access, whether its account can commit funds or communicate, whether its use is metered and its cost, the operations of a model provider that do not generate, the tools of its service that only read and the writer that declared it. Accepts the declaration of a connection, a change to a connection and the removal of a connection.
rationale: DEC-125. An agent knows what a problem needs, and the user consents at the service. DEC-058 holds a declaration with the system that refuses against it, and this system refuses a credential against the scopes and a call against the limit of DEC-165. REQ-PL-031 gives each declaration a new, a change and a removal, so the three are one capability, as FUN-AC-01 states for an act.

name: Credential Custody
definition: Accepts, holds, renews and revokes the credential of each declared connection.
rationale: DEC-032 and DEC-161 keep each credential of the platform in this system. DEC-125 has the credential come from the user. A credential that expires and is not renewed stops a source and an act, and a credential that is removed and not revoked still works at the service.

name: Credential Validity
definition: Finds a declared connection that has no valid credential, raises the work for it, and reports when the connection has a valid credential.
rationale: FUN-PL-13 names a credential that stops being valid as work that the platform raises, and DEC-168 has the system that cannot continue raise it. OPN-031. It is a capability apart from custody, as FUN-IN-04 is apart from FUN-IN-02.

name: Outbound Carriage
definition: Carries a call from a system inside the platform to an external service, and gives the caller its result or that it returned no result. Reports a change in the description that a service gives of the operation that a call names.
rationale: DEC-032 and DEC-123. The calls are the acts of Actuation, the acquisitions of Ingestion, the deliveries of Interaction and the calls to a model (DEC-161). How a service is reached is below this level.

name: Inbound Delivery
definition: Accepts a delivery that an external service sends without a request, and gives it to Ingestion.
rationale: DEC-032 and DEC-129. REQ-IN-004 accepts data that a source sends without a request, and this system is the only route from the outside.

name: Call Record
definition: Gives Self-Observation, for each call that it carries, the service, the system that called, the agent that the caller states, the time, the outcome, the usage and the cost.
rationale: DEC-032 records each exchange. DEC-169 holds the record of each act in Self-Observation from Actuation, so this record is of the call and not of the act, and it is where REQ-PL-017 finds the cost and the state of each service.

name: Off-host Carriage
definition: Carries each copy that a holder gives to the location away from the host, keeps it for the period that the platform keeps copies, and gives it back for a restoration.
rationale: DEC-020 and DEC-128. The holder decides when and gives a copy that is consistent, and this system holds where and for how long. OPN-040.

name: Admission by Position
definition: Refuses the declaration, the change or the removal of a connection from a caller whose position does not admit it, and a released gated unit whose raiser holds a position that does not admit its act.
rationale: DEC-123. This system holds the declared connections, and DEC-111 has each holder refuse by the position of the caller that Actuation states. FUN-IN-06 is the same capability in Ingestion.
